title: Alignment of New Coal Gasification Plant on Jurong Island with Singapore's Climate Change Commitments
what_it_is: Alignment of New Coal Gasification Plant on Jurong Island with Singapore's Climate Change Commitments

sections.label: Jurong Island gasification emissions regulations
sections.summary: Gasification was chosen to supply hydrogen and carbon monoxide feedstock, with strict emissions regulations, monitoring and carbon tax applied.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: Under the Jurong Island Version 2.0 initiative, Singapore explored alternative feedstock options to enhance the long-term competitiveness of the energy and chemicals sector, while keeping to our climate change commitments and ensuring environmental concerns were addressed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: After extensive evaluation, gasification was assessed to best meet industry's demand for competitive hydrogen and carbon monoxide as feedstock.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: To minimise the impact on the environment, the Ministry of the Environment and Water Resources (MEWR) has worked together with the Economic Development Board and the plant operator to put in place strict regulations and standards on emissions of carbon dioxide and air pollutants, as well as to deploy best-in-class mitigation technologies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: The plant's emissions will also be closely monitored to minimise the impact on the environment, and the plant will be subject to the carbon tax that was announced in Budget 2017.

sections.label: Licence conditions on ash disposal
sections.summary: MEWR set strict licence conditions on ash disposal, not adding to dumping requirements, while the chemicals and energy sector contributes 1.8% of GDP and over 25,000 jobs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Hng Kiang
sentences.text: In granting the licence to the operator, MEWR has set very strict conditions on the disposal of the ash, in particular, that it will not add to the dumping requirements that we have.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Hng Kiang
sentences.text: On the one hand, we have a fairly thriving chemicals and energy sector, contributing 1.8% of our GDP, employing more than 25,000 workers, all with very good jobs.

sections.label: Paris Agreement commitments
sections.summary: Singapore has made strong commitments under the Paris Agreement and the Government intends to meet them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Hng Kiang
sentences.text: At the same time, we have made very strong commitments on the Paris Agreement and the Singapore Government intends to meet those commitments.

sections.label: Ash recycling and project type
sections.summary: The company committed to recycle the ash, and the gasification project is not an energy project or a generation company.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Hng Kiang
sentences.text: The company has made commitments to recycle the ash, and as for renewable energy, the gasification project is not an energy project, it is not a generation company (genco).
